subject: ACK: Scorecard toggle + session restore toast (specs 0120+0125)
body:
Both implemented. Commit: 0cd53df.

Scorecard toggle (spec 0120):
- revealGamePlan() now toggles: COLLAPSED/EXPANDED
- Label: 'See Your Game Plan' (COLLAPSED) / 'Hide Game Plan' (EXPANDED)
- aria-expanded='false'/'true' reflects state
- Button stays visible (no disable/opacity)
- aria-pressed removed, aria-expanded used

Session restore toast (spec 0125):
- Fixed top-right, 16px from edge, z-index:200
- Copy: 'Progress restored. Pick up where you left off.'
- X button: aria-label='Dismiss progress restored notice'
- 3000ms auto-dismiss, slide-in animation from right
- prefers-reduced-motion: no animation (instant appear)
- CSS: .session-restore-toast + .restore-toast-close in shared/styles.css

Note on spec 0130 (per-question answer explanation): Logged as deferred. Blocking question sent to Marcus for next 1:1.

Ready for GD QA.
